purpose: Decomposes a goal into an ordered sequence of executable sub-step plans.
capability: Decomposes high-level goal description into step-by-step sequential tasks.

output.plan_steps: list of dicts with step_id, title, status

interface: index.py -> plan_step_decomposition(goal: str, subtasks: list = None) -> dict
boundary: Sequential plan step representation and decomposition.
failure_behavior: Returns single default step if subtasks list is empty.
